# Vikas Goyal

> Practical writing by Vikas Goyal, a customer-facing agentic AI solutions architect with 26 years in industry, on agentic AI systems, architectures, design patterns, evaluation and governance, plus generative AI, industry AI reports, startups and engineering careers.

Pages are static HTML. Where a page has a Markdown twin or machine-readable files, they are listed below; prefer those.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Agentic Pattern Library index](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/llms.txt): every agentic design pattern with its intent and link
- [Agentic Pattern Library full text](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/llms-full.txt): every pattern card as Markdown
- [Agentic Pattern Library JSON](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/patterns.json): structured fields per pattern
- [Agentic Pattern Library agent skill](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/skill/SKILL.md): drop-in SKILL.md for coding agents
- [Rego primer (Markdown)](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/rego-primer.md): Rego and OPA policy as code, with agent tool-call guardrails and Microsoft Foundry Agent Controls

## Agentic AI

- [Agentic AI hub](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/): entry point, organized by practice area
- [Agentic AI Design Patterns](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/): pattern library with diagrams, trade-offs and worked examples
- [Use the Pattern Library from your coding agent](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/patterns/for-agents/)
- [Rego, Explained by Example](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/rego-primer.html): policy as code for APIs, Kubernetes, Terraform and AI agents
- [Reference Architecture for Agentic AI](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/refarchagentic.html)
- [A Practical Taxonomy for Agentic AI Systems](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/agenticai-types.html)
- [MCP as a foundational layer of the AI-native internet](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/mcpfoundation.html)
- [Open Responses: a primer on the open LLM API specification](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/openresponses.html)
- [From LLMs to Action Models](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/actionmodels.html)
- [System 1 Models: a practical guide to decision models](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/design/system-1-models.html)
- [Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) Reference Architecture](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/refarchmas.html)
- [Agentic AI: a strategic overview for CXOs](https://vikasgoyal.github.io/agentic/agenticai.html)
